Scamsters of Blue Hills

By: Sibusisiwe Buthelezi | Commission

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
We expose a property development scam that targeted desperate South Africans hoping to be homeowners.

Unique Selling Point:
Blue Hills is buzzing with new developments... but not all developers are legitimate.

Summary:
We expose New Choice Quality, a property development company that set up shop in Midrand. The owner, Kamogelo Matuludi, claimed that he owned land that apartments and stand alone houses were going to be built on. It turns out, he does not own the land and the families who've paid him to purchase the homes will never see that dream become a reality.

Further information:
We have verified with the owner of the land, we have spoken to over 30 case studies who paid monies to Kamogelo, we have an architect that was also scammed by Kamogelo and New Choice Quality.

Drone footage
